About Me

I am a researcher at École Polytechnique and Inria Saclay, working on generative AI for discrete structured data, including diffusion and flow-matching models for molecular graphs and symbolic scientific structures. With Sanofi, I align large language models to accelerate pharmacology.

{/* VISION */}

Research Vision

My long-term vision is to build autonomous scientific agents capable of reasoning over discrete hypothesis spaces, proposing experiments, refining molecular candidates, and interacting with scientific literature.
